title: Spaghetti Cacio e Pepe
description: This spaghetti cacio e pepe recipe is made with cheese, olive oil, pepper, and garlic for a delicious side or simple dinner that's made in 20 minutes.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Reserve 1 cup cooking water, then drain spaghetti.

Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir garlic and pepper in hot oil until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes. Add cooked spaghetti and Pecorino Romano cheese. Ladle in 1/2 cup reserved cooking water; stir until cheese is melted, about 1 minute. Stir in more cooking water as needed, 1 tablespoon at a time, until sauce coats spaghetti, about 1 minute more.

video.description: There’s a reason why some recipes earn the title of classic—when simplicity and great flavor come together, you’re almost certain to have earned that name. Best of all, this recipe comes together in no time. First garlic and pepper intermingle on the heat, then mix with cooked spaghetti, Pecorino Romano cheese. Finally, a portion of pasta water is added to make a terrific sauce. Better grab a plate—your fork can’t wait to twirl up big mouthfuls of this tasty pasta.
